propositions: Backfill close_class for already-closed bugs lacking it using only structural signals: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event infers regression; plan-review BLOCK verdict infers plan_defect; gate_error_v1 ERROR record infers env_integration; otherwise undetermined.
Bugs already possessing state["close_class"] must be skipped and not re-backfilled; idempotency is enforced by tracking ticket_id in .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson.

Backfilled classifications are written to a separate, tracked NDJSON artifact (.rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson) with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate them from authoritative go-forward values.
REVERT signal must target a substantive event type (STATUS or COMMITS), not comment/link events, to qualify as regression.

plan-review BLOCK signal must be read via all_review_results (which filters to plan_review_result_v2); gate_error_v1 signals require raw event-file scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files.
